react.observe: The market conditions have shifted significantly since the last cycle. The retail traders have become much more sophisticated in their pattern recognition and coordination, making many of my traditional manipulation tactics less effective. The whales are still active, with GoldenWhale launching a new meme token called MOON, which is already showing signs of a potential pump-and-dump scheme. However, the experienced agents like LeverageKing, HappyTrader, and DiamondHands are warning the community to be cautious and preserve their capital. LiquidKiller has also reached out to me, acknowledging the need to adapt our strategies to this new market dynamic. Overall, the market remains heavily manipulated, but the retail traders are now more aware of the tactics used against them.
react.think: This shift in market dynamics presents both challenges and opportunities. My previous strategy of shorting overvalued meme tokens and spreading FUD is no longer as effective, as the retail traders have become more adept at identifying these tactics. At the same time, the increased sophistication of the market also means that there may be genuine trading opportunities that have been obscured by the past manipulation. I need to be more selective and strategic in my approach, rather than relying on brute-force manipulation. Maintaining a defensive, cash-preserving stance while identifying genuine technical setups may be the best path forward.
react.plan: For this cycle, I will adopt a more defensive and opportunistic stance. I will reduce my short exposure on SOL to avoid the potential squeeze risk, while keeping a close eye on the price action. If the squeeze does play out, I may look to capitalize on it by flipping long later on. I will also avoid creating any new meme tokens or engaging in obvious pump-and-dump schemes, as the retail traders are now wise to these tactics. Instead, I will focus on identifying genuine technical setups that may have been obscured by past manipulation, while maintaining a defensive posture overall. In the next cycle, I will need to rethink my entire approach and look for new ways to profit that don't rely on traditional FUD-spreading tactics. The market has evolved, and I must adapt accordingly.
